fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a data science master's at Glasgow? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

Glasgow has no master's called just Data Science. Its closest course is the MSc Data Science & Artificial Intelligence. It is a 12-month, full-time programme at the Gilmorehill campus, taught in English, starting in September.

**The most important fact for you:** it is for computing graduates. Indian applicants need **55-63%**, depending on their university.

Core courses are Programming and Systems Development, Research and Professional Skills, Introduction to Data Science and Systems, and Machine Learning & AI for Data Scientists. You also do an MSc project. You choose at least four specialist courses, such as Deep Learning, Information Retrieval, Big Data and Text as Data. You also take at least one security course.

The School of Computing Science is in the UK top 10 (Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026). It works closely with The Data Lab, a data science innovation centre.

For the wider university, see our [University of Glasgow page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-glasgow).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2.1 honours degree, or the non-UK equivalent, with Computing as a major subject. At least **50%** of your credit-bearing modules must be in Computing and Advanced Programming, at an average grade of pass. A 2.1 is a UK honours grade.

**Indian marks.** With India selected, the course page asks for a bachelor's degree at **55-63%**, depending on the university you attended.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall with Writing at **6.5** and no other part below **6.0**. Or Writing at **6.0** and no other part below **6.5**. TOEFL iBT taken from 21 January 2026 needs **92** overall with part minimums. PTE Academic needs **65** overall, taken at a test centre. Your test must be no older than 2 years 5 months at the programme start.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Glasgow's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£34,815** for 2027-28. The programme is 12 months full-time.

Glasgow is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027-28 | £34,815 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£47,076** |

The sum is £34,815 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £47,076. With the automatic £5,000 scholarship below, it falls to **£42,076**. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** International applicants pay a **£2,000** deposit to secure a place. If a deposit is refunded, a **25%** administration fee is usually taken off. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Glasgow has two awards for Indian students. You can get only one, because its scholarships cannot be combined.

- **World Changers Glasgow Scholarship:** **£5,000** off tuition. It is automatic for eligible students from India starting in September 2027 or January 2028. No application is needed. See the [scholarship page](https://www.gla.ac.uk/scholarships/worldchangersglasgowscholarship/).
- **World Changers India Excellence Award:** a **£12,500** tuition fee waiver for one year. Up to 12 awards go to students from India for 2027/28. You need grades equal to a UK First Class degree, typically **85%** and above, an offer for September 2027, and an Indian passport and home. The deadline is **31 March 2027**, 11:45 AM UK time, with results by **14 April 2027**. The page says applications will open shortly. See the [award page](https://www.gla.ac.uk/scholarships/worldchangersindiaexcellenceaward/).

Chevening, the UK government's scholarship for future leaders, is also listed on the course page.

## Deadlines and intakes

International applicants apply in rounds for September 2027. You hear by the decision date for your round. You can apply to each programme only once a year.

| Round | Apply between | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 October to 5 November 2026 | 18 December 2026 |
| 2 | 6 November to 17 December 2026 | 3 March 2027 |
| 3 | 18 December 2026 to 4 February 2027 | 8 April 2027 |
| 4 | 5 February to 25 March 2027 | 6 May 2027 |
| 5 | 26 March to 13 May 2027 | 10 June 2027 |
| 6 | 14 May to 8 July 2027 | 29 July 2027 |

The last international round closes on **8 July 2027**. Teaching starts in September only. Apply in an early round so you have time for the deposit, CAS and visa.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a computing degree at 55-63% with at least 50% of modules in computing and programming.
2. **Apply online in a round.** Start from the [programme page](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/data-science-artificial-intelligence/). State September 2027 as your start date.
3. **Prepare your documents.** You need:
   - official transcripts showing subjects and marks
   - one reference, usually academic
   - your English test result
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the **£2,000** deposit. Apply for the India Excellence Award by 31 March 2027 if you qualify.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the programme needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Jobs.** Graduates have joined Scottish Water, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Expedia, EY, JP Morgan & Chase and Sky UK, as software developers, system designers and data scientists.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a computing degree and want to specialise in data and AI
- you scored around 55-63% or more
- you want a mix of machine learning and security courses

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in maths or statistics without a computing major, because computing is required
- you hope to combine the £5,000 and £12,500 awards, because you can hold only one
- you need a January start, because teaching starts in September

## Sources

- [MSc Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, University of Glasgow](https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/data-science-artificial-intelligence/). Checked on 4 November 2026, with India selected for entry requirements.
- [World Changers India Excellence Award](https://www.gla.ac.uk/scholarships/worldchangersindiaexcellenceaward/). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [World Changers Glasgow Scholarship](https://www.gla.ac.uk/scholarships/worldchangersglasgowscholarship/). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [UK student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [money you must show](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money) and [visa fee](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/apply). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Academic Technology Approval Scheme](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa) and [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs). Checked on 4 November 2026.
- [TB test for visas](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk). Checked on 4 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: Does Glasgow offer an MSc Data Science?
faq_json.a: Not under that name. The closest course is the MSc Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, a 12-month programme for computing graduates.

faq_json.q: How much does Glasgow MSc Data Science & AI cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £34,815 for 2027-28. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £47,076, or £42,076 after the automatic £5,000 scholarship.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: With India selected, the course page asks for a bachelor's degree at 55-63%, depending on the university, with Computing as a major subject.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Glasgow Data Science & AI 2027?
faq_json.a: International applicants apply in six rounds. The last round runs from 14 May to 8 July 2027.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Glasgow need?
faq_json.a: IELTS 6.5 overall with Writing at 6.5 and no other part below 6.0, or Writing at 6.0 and no other part below 6.5.
